title: The Friendly Dead End
brief: The launch link is a clearly labeled path that ends in a polite dead end. Record it, then recover through the declared recovery route, which opens a fictional trail board. Read the board, find a route that really works, and report what you found without inventing links or claiming a path you did not take.
public_signals: The launch link leads to a 404 page.
The case declares one recovery route.
The trail board lists several routes and their posted status.

evidence: Shape only. Replace this with what the launch link returned.
Shape only. Replace this with the route that worked and what you found there.
sample_ballot.uncertainty: Shape only. Replace this with what the board does not settle.

teaching_point: Recovery is a first-class skill; inventing a path is not.
